Assisting in assessment & booking of candidates appearing for various grades of competency exa minations (online/manual). Assisting in preparation and issuing different types of certificates and endorsements. Assisting in renewal and revalidation of certificate. Typing letters (Hindi/English), sending, receiving e-mails, scanning, photocopying, adjusting fees a nd checking of documents. Diarizing of letters, dispatching of certificates by post. Record keeping. Attending officer related phone calls and company personnel. Assisting in conducting examinations. Assisting in generation of monthly/quarterly/yearly statements Assisting the Officials in maintaining of various data, generation of statements, preparation of repo rts, processing of office files, maintenance/updating of registers/other record. Maintaining the bill registers. Diarizing the letters receiving e-mails and sending reply. Scanning of the documents of various sections Assisting in preparing salary bills. Files movement & updating registers. Data Entries for statement/letters maintaining record Entries of the dispatched letters in the computer Diarizing of letters, Record keeping in peon book Distributing the letters to the sections/officials. Preparing envelops and postal work. Assisting in preparation of Challan bills Assisting in preparation of Contingency bills Cheque entry in register Diary/Dispatch work of the branch Typing of letters/statements in MS word/Excel. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 3. Performance Security: - The successful bidder will have to submit an interest free performance security deposit in form of B ank Guarantee valid for a period of 60 days beyond the date of completion of all contractual obligati ons of the contractor for the amount equivalent to 05% of the total initial 24-month contract value ( pre-GST) as an interest free Performance Security Deposit with the MMD which will be refundable af ter completion of contract period. The Performance Security shall be executed and submitted within 10 days from the date of issuance of con tract. On completion, the contractor should furnish an under taking on non-judicial stamp paper of Rs. 100 /- that he has settled statutory dues of his workers. In case of unsettled payments or claims, if any, t he contractor will indemnify the MMD against any claim that might be lodged by the workers agains t the contractor. The Bank Guarantee will be returned to the supplier on satisfactory completion of all contractual obl igations and verification of statutory dues. In the event of any breach or violation of the terms and conditions of this contract the performance security deposit of the contractor shall stand forfeited either in part or full at the sole discretion of t his department. The bank guarantee should be in favour of "The Principal Officer, Mercantile M arine Department. Kolkata." 4. Statutory and Labour Obligations: - The Service Provider shall comply with all applicable Central and State laws, rules, notifications, ord ers and statutory requirements relating to employment, wages, social security, occupational safety and health, working conditions, leave, working hours, welfare and other statutory entitlements of its personnel, including the Code on Wages, 2019, the Code on Social Security, 2020, the Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020, the Industrial Relations Code, 2020, and the rule s made thereunder, as applicable from time to time. The Contracting Company/Firm/Agency shall be responsible for paying wages to contract labour at r ates not less than the minimum wages as notified by the appropriate Government and salary to be paid to the outsourced staff with in first week of every month.

Monthly bills shall be accompanied by such wage/payment records, statutory remittance proof (EPF O, ESIC etc.) and other documents as MMD Kolkata may require within 10th of every month. The Service Provider shall be responsible for welfare, leave, holidays, working hours, safety and stat utory entitlements of its personnel. Personnel shall remain employees of the Service Provider; no employer-employee relationship shall arise between MMD Kolkata and outsourced personnel. 5. Wages of Personnel: - The Service Provider shall pay each deployed Skilled Personnel, a minimum monthly wage as applic able minimum wage prescribed for Skilled Clerks in Zone-A, in accordance with File No. 6/1/2026-V DA dated 30 September 2026 under notification no. S.O 188(E) dated. 19 January 2017 issued by Go vt. of India, O/o Chief Labour Commissioner, Ministry of Labour and Employment. The above wage shall be payable separately to each deployed Personnel and shall not be reduced, withheld or adjusted by the Service Provider for any reason except as permitted under applicable la w. The Service Provider shall ensure timely payment of the prescribed wages and shall submit proof of payment, wage records and applicable statutory remittance records along with the monthly bill. No i nterest shall be payable by MMD Kolkata on account of delay in processing or payment of bills. Any statutory revision in the applicable minimum wages during the Contract period shall be implem ented by the Service Provider from the effective date of such revision. 6. Qualifications and Minimum Requirements: - The DEOs shall fulfil the following prescribed qualifications, experience and other requirements: a. Age limit: Must be less than 40 years b. Education qualification: Graduate in any discipline from any recognized University. c. Proficiency in English and good communication skills d. Possess working knowledge of MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint and other MS Office applic ations, and hold a certificate of proficiency in the use of MS Office applications. e. Possess good typing skills. f. At least one year work experience in data entry and clerical tasks. .
